QuestInfo.name: [Arteria] To the Front Lines
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart has assigned you to join Eckhart n the front lines. Gaon has volunteered to go with you. Speak with #bKiriru#k, take a #bSky Ferry#k, and go help Eckhart.
QuestInfo.2: The High Flora Army's battleship is bombarding Ereve and breaking down its barriers. Enemy dropships have already entered through the breaches. Meet Kidan in the Supply Depot and help bolster the defense.
QuestInfo.0: The High Flora Army is attacking all corners of Maple World. The Cygnus Knights are mounting a defense on all fronts. Talk to #bNeinheart#k in the Operations Center for instructions.

npc.0: Go receive your orders from Kidan in the Supply Depot.
